Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & MAP draft: Integration Build Plan (SDK + Streaming + Tool Calling)

Hi Samantha / Tom,

Thanks for the productive call this morning - appreciate the clarity on the use cases. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone focused on the Integration Build Plan (SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs). High level items I captured:

- Milestone 1: SDK Integration (client libs + auth) - owner: Acme dev lead (Tom) / Redwood SDK eng (Dev Patel)
- Milestone 2: Streaming + Prefix Caching (real-time telemetry pipeline) - owner: Acme platform (Samantha) / Redwood infra (Connor O'Brien)
- Milestone 3: Tool Calling & Structured Outputs (task routing to internal tools, JSON schema) - owner: Acme product (Samantha) / Redwood applied ML (Rishi)
- Dependencies: Network egress rules, API keys/KMS, IP allowlist for dedicated nodes, test data set for structured output validation
- Target close: 2027-01-15 (initial POC), with GA/production target TBD based on integration velocity

Next steps I recommend:
1) Please review the attached "ACME_MAP_v1.2.xlsx" and confirm owners & realistic dates by EOD Monday PST.
2) Dev Patel: can you add a short SDK integration checklist (OS support, streaming SDK hooks, auth flows) into the sheet?
3) Connor: please note infra prerequisites we need to surface to Acme (VPC peering, firewall rules).

I'll consolidate changes and circulate v1.3. If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to lock owners and the target close.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (spreadsheet), integration_diagram.png (png)

Marissa / Tom - jumping in with technical notes and initial owner breakdown from Redwood: 

- SDK Integration checklist (high level):
  * Supported languages: python, java, node (we'll provide examples)
  * Auth: API key + optional mTLS for Dedicated/Private (we can provide KMS integration docs)
  * Streaming: client-side streaming API with reconnect/backoff and prefix caching (we'll deliver an example client)
  * Versioning: model pinning and compatibility matrix

- Proposed owners / tasks (Redwood):
  * SDK examples + auth flows: Dev Patel (owner) - ETA: 2026-12-10 for initial examples
  * Streaming sample & reconnects: Connor O'Brien (owner) - ETA: 2026-12-17
  * Tool calling schema & JSON output templates: Rishi Malhotra (owner) - ETA: 2026-12-20

- Sandbox & test data: we can spin a sandbox endpoint and issue testing keys for Acme. Need approvals from security; Marissa can help route the request.

I'll add these items into the attached MAP spreadsheet and label them with the owners/dates.

Thanks Dev - this is helpful. A few points from our infra/product side:

- POC target: we can accept 2027-01-22 for POC (Tom's note). GA target will depend on performance tests but tentatively aim for 2027-03-15.
- Dependencies: we'll own providing test data and the initial schema for the structured outputs. Expect deliverable from Acme product by 2026-12-08.
- Security: we need the sandbox to support IP-based allowlist and short-lived tokens - can Redwood accommodate?

Small ask: can you add a line item in the MAP that calls out who will own the acceptance criteria for each milestone (i.e., who signs off on POC vs. who signs off on GA)?

I'll review v1.3 when you circulate.

Thanks,

- Acceptance criteria: I'll add infra acceptance items to the MAP (latency threshold, auth verification, streaming stability tests). Proposed acceptance owners: Acme (POC sign-off: Samantha), Redwood (GA readiness sign-off: Connor + Eng manager).
